title: How Does Your Body Feel Today?

fb.caption:
How Does Your Body Feel Today? Tiny aches taking a small step down, or still a bit twitchy around the edges? Space is settled today—steady conditions that can ease the jolty stuff for some people, even if you are not feeling better yet.

Think low-friction starts. Begin with slow joint circles and easy range-of-motion before errands or chores; warming tissues first can make everyday moves feel less stabby. Then work in small chunks with brief breathers so any background soreness doesn’t pile up. Stay hydrated and don’t sprint into the morning; quiet skies can help, but local humidity, pressure, and allergens still set the tone. Gaia Eyes tracks the space-side steadiness against how bodies report stiffness, sparkiness, and ease here on the ground.
